text: hey claude here is something that... i dont really understand lol. so i have this model. its exactly waht i want it to be [Image #1] and looks clean. i want to move the model now down to the ground of this view so that it is at ground level in the game. so i put it in object mode, select move, and then when i move it at all. i get this message [Image #2] conncave face 2 faces bukcled not convex
resolution: Root-caused the spurious 'Concave face — N faces buckled' dialog that fired whenever an object was moved in the Studio mesh editor. The gizmo commit guard ran findConcaveFaces() over the ENTIRE result mesh, so any organic/carved part (the user's tree) that legitimately contains concave quads got re-flagged on every move — even though object-mode move is a rigid translation of all verts (indices = mesh.verts.map) that changes no face's convexity. Added newConcaveFaces(before, after) to editMesh.ts which flags only faces the edit NEWLY buckled (concave in after, not concave at the same index in before; falls back to a full scan if face topology changed). StudioViewport.tsx's gizmo-drag commit now diffs against g.startMesh instead of scanning the whole result. A genuine corner-pull that reflexes a quad still raises the Split Quads dialog. Added a regression test; all 93 editMesh suites pass. Studio.tsx is the frozen breadcrumb and was left untouched.
